outcomes.formal_desc: Explain the phases of a compiler and the role of each phase in syntax-directed translation.
outcomes.practical_translation: Understanding how raw source code text moves from lexical analysis (tokens) to AST generation and machine assembly emission.
outcomes.applied_task: Tracing source code compilation steps through lexical scanner, parser, and intermediate 3-address code generation.
outcomes.resume_impact: Understood low-level program compilation lifecycles and syntax-directed translation pipelines.

outcomes.formal_desc: Identify the similarities and differences among various parsing techniques and grammar transformation techniques.
outcomes.practical_translation: Eliminating left recursion from Context-Free Grammars (CFG) and constructing LL(1) or LR shift-reduce parsing tables.
outcomes.applied_task: Designing an LL(1) parsing table manually and resolving grammar ambiguity for arithmetic expressions.
outcomes.resume_impact: Built formal grammar parsing tables and handled syntax analysis for custom domain-specific languages.

outcomes.formal_desc: Design compiler optimization techniques to improve the performance and efficiency of generated machine code.
outcomes.practical_translation: Analyzing intermediate code patterns to perform dead code elimination, constant folding, and register allocation optimizations.
outcomes.applied_task: Writing target machine code optimization passes to strip redundant stack operations and instructions.
outcomes.resume_impact: Engineered intermediate code optimization algorithms to reduce compiled binary execution overhead.

outcomes.formal_desc: Remember and understand the basic concepts of computer graphics, raster display architectures, and Look-Up Tables (LUT).
outcomes.practical_translation: Understanding pixel framebuffers, refresh rates, screen resolutions, and anti-aliasing techniques in modern display drivers.
outcomes.applied_task: Analyzing raster vs. random scan architectures and LUT color mapping tables.
outcomes.resume_impact: Understood raster display pipeline mechanics, framebuffer architectures, and digital color representation.

outcomes.formal_desc: Describe and apply the mathematical principles of computer graphics on 2D and 3D geometric objects.
outcomes.practical_translation: Applying 2D/3D transformation matrices (Translation, Scaling, Rotation, Shearing, Reflection) using homogeneous coordinates.
outcomes.applied_task: Calculating composite 3D transformation matrices for object rotation and perspective projection.
outcomes.resume_impact: Implemented linear algebra matrix transformations for rendering 2D/3D vector geometries.

outcomes.formal_desc: Implement and analyze computer graphics algorithms and techniques for graphical modeling and visualization.
outcomes.practical_translation: Coding line/circle rasterization algorithms (DDA, Bresenham) and polygon clipping algorithms (Cohen-Sutherland, Liang-Barsky).
outcomes.applied_task: Implementing Midpoint Circle generation and Sutherland-Hodgman polygon clipping routines.
outcomes.resume_impact: Coded core graphics rasterization and view window clipping algorithms for geometric rendering engine.

outcomes.formal_desc: Explain the structure and technologies used in multimedia systems, color models, and file encoding formats.
outcomes.practical_translation: Working with digital video/audio encoding formats, RGB/CMY/YIQ color spaces, and timeline keyframe animation principles.
outcomes.applied_task: Comparing lossy vs. lossless compression specs for multimedia streaming formats.
outcomes.resume_impact: Analyzed digital signal compression algorithms, CIE chromaticity models, and multimedia streaming formats.

outcomes.formal_desc: Explain microprocessor and microcontroller internal architecture, physical memory organization, and CISC/RISC operations.
outcomes.practical_translation: Navigating segment/offset register memory mapping (CS, DS, SS, IP) in x86 8086 execution environments.
outcomes.applied_task: Calculating 20-bit physical memory addresses from 16-bit segment and offset register pairs.
outcomes.resume_impact: Mastered low-level x86/8051 hardware memory architectures and bus system mechanics.

outcomes.formal_desc: Analyze the structure of high-level vs low-level languages and explain program execution via machine instruction cycles.
outcomes.practical_translation: Tracing opcode execution, CPU flag changes, instruction queue behavior, and stack operations (PUSH/POP/CALL).
outcomes.applied_task: Tracing CPU register states through multi-byte string data transfer and conditional jump instruction sets.
outcomes.resume_impact: Analyzed machine instruction cycles, register flag manipulation, and call stack memory operations.

outcomes.formal_desc: Design and analyze the integration of microprocessor and microcontroller-based systems focusing on problem solving.

outcomes.applied_task: Designing an interrupt-driven peripheral communication interface using 8086 and 8259 PIC controllers.
outcomes.resume_impact: Designed hardware peripheral interfacing logic using programmable interrupt controllers and I/O buses.

outcomes.resume_impact: Architected embedded hardware solutions utilizing microcontroller timers, converters, and memory bus logic.

outcomes.applied_task: Debugging low-level assembly execution inside EMU8086 step-by-step debugger view.
outcomes.resume_impact: Proficient in inspecting CPU registers, memory segment offsets, and flags using emulator debug tools.
